reference.citation: McGraw KO, Wong SP (1996) intraclass correlation. Reference impls: psych::ICC(lmer=FALSE) (Revelle) and pingouin.intraclass_corr. Data: COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) across 3 repeated eyes-open-firm quiet-standing trials, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS.
reference.description: re-computes the ICC forms of the 3-trial COP path length with psych::ICC(lmer=FALSE) and pingouin.intraclass_corr and confirms intraclassCorrelation reproduces both; also reports the single-trial (ICC2,1) and 3-trial-average (ICC2,k) reliabilities and the design sizes
